title: Add an Orval-generated API client
description: Add an API client generated by Orval from an OpenAPI spec: a new library, or an Orval config in an existing project. The first generation runs once the install finishes.

examples.description: Client library for a spec that lives in another project
Client library for a remote spec
Library in a chosen folder, with zod validation schemas
Add Orval to an existing project instead of creating a library

name.description: API name: the Orval project key and the library name. With --project it defaults to the project's name.

directory.description: Where to create the library, relative to the current directory. Defaults to <name> in the first workspaces folder (packages/*), or libs/<name> without workspaces.

project.description: Add the Orval config to this existing project instead of creating a library. Needs --spec or an openapi.* file in its root.

spec.description: OpenAPI spec: a workspace-relative path or an http(s) URL. Omit for a sample (new library) or the project's openapi.* file (--project).
spec.x-prompt: Path or URL of the OpenAPI spec (leave empty for a sample)

httpClient.description: HTTP layer for query clients (react-query, vue-query, swr, ...). Orval's default when omitted.

validation.description: Also generate runtime validation schemas for the API, in src/generated/<validation>.

tags.description: Comma-separated Nx tags for the new library.

linter.description: Linter for a new library. Defaults to the linter the workspace already uses.

skipGenerate.description: Do not run the Orval target after the install. src/generated stays missing until you run it.
